snippet.title: Starstorm 2 v0.6.8 Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Starstorm 2 returns! Now playable with Seekers of the Storm, with a few new bonuses to discover yourself. 😉

Trailer by UnknownGlaze.

Download Starstorm 2: https://thunderstore.io/package/TeamMoonstorm/Starstorm2/
Chat on Discord: https://discord.gg/SgFxwKT7nY
Follow us on Twitter:https://x.com/StarstormMod

The following dependency is recommended to resolve a vanilla physics bug primarily affecting enemies after being thrown by Chirr: https://thunderstore.io/package/pseudopulse/EnemyImportance/
